# Field Mag

> > Field Mag covers outdoor lifestyle, innovative gear, sustainable design, and adventure travel through product reviews and cultural storytelling.

Field Mag is an outdoor lifestyle publication featuring cutting-edge gear reviews, eco-conscious travel destinations, and design-forward products for adventurers and urban explorers. The site highlights innovative materials like Gore-Tex Infinium, sustainable tourism projects, and emerging brands in cycling, camping, and everyday outdoor equipment.

## Key Topics

- Outdoor lifestyle and adventure gear
- Sustainable and eco-conscious design
- Innovative materials (Gore-Tex, textile technology)
- Cycling gear and bike security
- Agricultural tourism and eco-hotels
- Kickstarter products and emerging brands
- Weather-resistant outdoor equipment
- Geometric architecture and cabin design
- Made in USA outdoor goods
- Industrial design innovation
- Camping and picnic equipment
- Brand collaborations and partnerships
- European outdoor brands (Germany, Rapha)
- Sustainable travel destinations
- Urban outdoor culture
